messages:
Ana CSM: Need a tiny customer-facing "pocket guide" for onboarding that AEs can paste into kickoff notes. Focus: prefill, jitter/retry, batching, streaming fallback, renewal triggers.
Ravi SE: Keep it copy-paste ready. Add exact numbers (TTL, batch targets, alert thresholds).
Tess DevEx: I'll draft two snippets: prefill curl + PromQL healthcheck.
Liam PM: Also include a single-sentence 'what we guarantee' for customers.
Ana CSM: Draft 1-liner for AEs: "We will prefill your top 8 intents and monitor p95; warm window ~10 minutes."
Ravi SE: Ops knobs (for internal teams): prefill_ttl=900s (increase to 1800s if stateful), warm_pool=enabled for >200rps, burst_pool_ttl=300s, batch_target_tokens=1024.
Tess DevEx: Prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-qa-1","intents":["lookup","summarize"],"ttl":900}'
```
Tess DevEx: PromQL healthcheck (copy):
```
100 * sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_total[5m]))
```
Ravi SE: Client pattern: jitter (0-200ms) + 2 retries for short ops; on sustained stream failures (>8% in 10m) fall back to non-streaming path and open SE ticket.
Ana CSM: Renewal signals (copy): sustained p95 > 1s for 24h, cache hit < 40% for 48h, stream error > 8% for 3 days, week-over-week cost spike >20%.
Liam PM: Add AE email snippet: "We detected increased latency on key flows. We're enabling warm capacity and will follow up with metrics within 24h."
OpsBot: Confluence page created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/pocket-guide-prefill-jitter
Ana CSM: Perfect. I'll add to the kickoff deck and share with the AE. Thanks all :tada:
